LESSON: CAPACITY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.3: Capacity
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Capacity, part of Measurement in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: What can we use to measure capacity?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Capacity together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: Learners identify the resources within the school environment for use in estimating capacity up to 5 Litres and

measure to confirm using 1 Litre containers

Values:
Peace: Learners develop care as they avoid hurting their peers and in turns practise addition of capacity in litres in real life situations.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Safety: In pairs or groups, learners are guided to collect safe materials in their immediate environment to be used to measure capacity.

Environmental Education and Climate change: Keeping surroundings clean and neat as the learner navigates their environment as they

collect safe materials for measuring capacity.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate collection of safe materials in their immediate environment for learning to waste management in Environmental

Activities.

Suggested Learning resources:

Containers of different sizes, 1 litre containers, sand, soil, water, 5 litre containers, digital devices
